Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORred
Exhibition name: Asso di Cuori ®
rows.Bloom: Dark red. None to mild fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Large, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Large, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 3' (up to 90cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Heat tolerant. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood..
rows.Notes: Some people say it has a fragrance, some say it doesn't.
